observation: The direct WorkspaceService.read path still used permissive UTF-8 decoding after contextBundle had become strict, so /api/file could present synthesized replacement characters for malformed repository bytes.
pre_fix_reproduction: Reading a .js file containing 0xff returned a string instead of failing closed.
change: Reuse the strict UTF-8 decoder for direct text reads and normalize malformed text to FILE_NOT_READABLE.
truth_boundary: Binary access remains available through readBytes; this change only tightens the text-read contract.
